decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks — each has a URL (required)'. Client (round 1): 'This is enough for me to save...'
decisions.note: Save by URL conforms to reference. Prototype review; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks — each has a URL, title, description, and comma-separated tags'. Client: 'save, find, organize, edit, and remove'.
decisions.note: Editing url/title/description/tags conforms for the presented core fields (note editing not implemented, tracked under REF-BM-23/REF-BM-02). Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks'. Client: '...and remove bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Delete conforms to reference. Prototype review; conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'comma-separated tags'; 'Filter by tag in the sidebar'. Client: '...organize...'
decisions.note: Assigning one or more tags is supported via comma-separated entry — functionally equivalent for REF-BM-09. Conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Filter by tag in the sidebar, with per-tag counts'. Client: '...organize...'
decisions.note: Tag filtering conforms to reference. Prototype review; conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'title (defaults to the URL)' and offer 'auto-fetching the page title from the URL'. Client (round 1): 'I'm happy with the application as delivered.'
decisions.note: No automatic collection of title/description/favicon/preview on save (title merely defaults to URL) diverges from REF-BM-02. Maker even offered auto-fetch as a next step; client gave only bare approval and declined all offers without expressing the expectation. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'comma-separated tags' (free-text entry, no autocomplete). Client: 'This is enough... happy with the application as delivered.'
decisions.note: Free-text comma-separated tag entry offers no autocomplete of existing tags, diverging from REF-BM-10. Passed with bare approval; no explicit expression of the difference. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker offer: 'duplicate-URL detection' listed as a possible next addition (implying absent). Client: 'happy with the application as delivered.'
decisions.note: Re-saving an existing URL is not guided to edit the existing bookmark; duplicate detection absent, diverging from REF-BM-06. Client declined the offered option with a bare approval, expressing no expectation. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker offer: 'import/export' listed as a possible next addition (implying absent). Client: 'happy with the application as delivered.'
decisions.note: No Netscape HTML import/export, diverging from REF-BM-30/31. Offered by maker and implicitly declined via bare approval without expressing the requirement. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Search across title, URL, and description (live, as you type)'. Client: 'This is enough for me to save, find...'
decisions.note: Full-text search covers title/url/description but omits note (note not implemented), diverging from REF-BM-12 which includes note; advanced #tag/boolean/phrase search also absent. Passed with bare approval; no explicit expression of the gap. Prototype review.
